patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large, vertically oriented brand name on the right, contrasting with a blurred, full-bleed product image on the left.
Extensive use of full-bleed, high-quality editorial photography as primary visual content or background elements across most sections.
A distinctive burnt orange/terracotta color is consistently applied to product packaging, serving as a strong visual accent against a largely neutral palette of dark browns/blacks and off-whites.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant, high-contrast serif font for display headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating an editorial feel.

The hero section features a parallax effect where the background image blurs and scrolls at a different rate than the foreground elements, while a large vertical brand name sticks to the right edge of the viewport.
Sections frequently alternate between dark (near-black) and light (off-white/beige) backgrounds, often featuring large, centered product or lifestyle photography.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered parallax effect where the background image blurs and translates upwards as the user scrolls, while a large, vertical brand name element remains fixed or slowly parallaxes on the right side of the viewport.

The site uses CSS keyframe animations for subtle reveals and transitions, likely for elements entering the viewport or for interactive states, though specific scroll-triggered reveals beyond the hero are not explicitly shown in the sequence.
The primary navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility throughout the scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (approx. 3-4x body size) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a luxurious and editorial hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and input fields have a very slight rounding, almost sharp; product packaging is rounded).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and within the hero section, creating a sense of luxury and allowing imagery to breathe).

standout: The distinctive use of a large, vertical, sticky brand name in the hero section combined with the unique burnt orange product packaging color and high-end editorial photography creates a strong, memorable brand identity that feels more like a luxury magazine than a typical e-commerce site.
